stem: An analyst scores RFM recency with NTILE(5), ordering customers by days since their last order from fewest to most days, so the customers with the fewest days get score 1. What goes wrong?

options.text: The latest buyers get the lowest R score, so recency runs the wrong way
Nothing: NTILE puts each customer in the same fifth in either order
Only customers with the same recency are affected, since NTILE splits ties
The R scores are right, but the frequency scores are now reversed
